prompt:
[Figure 1]

The graph shown models the number of members of a community club $x$ years after $2005$. How many members does this model estimate the club had in $2005$?
explanation: Choice C is correct. Since $x$ represents years after $2005$, the year $2005$ corresponds to $x = 0$. On the graph shown, the point with an x-coordinate of $0$ has a y-coordinate of $8{,}000$. Thus, the model estimates that in $2005$, the club had $8{,}000$ members.
